scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && tsc -p functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-stok-pro-rules-test "npx tsx scripts/test_firestore_rules.ts"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-stok-satis-test "npx tsx scripts/test_firestore_integration.ts"
scripts.test:repositories: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-stok-satis-test "npx tsx scripts/test_production_repositories.ts"
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-stok-satis-test "npx tsx scripts/test_firestore_rules.ts && npx tsx scripts/test_firestore_integration.ts && npx tsx scripts/test_production_repositories.ts"
